results.question: I'm running my first Session Zero next week. Any tips?

answer.text:
To run a successful Session Zero, follow these steps:

1. [1] **Set the Table**: Confirm a regular day, time, and session length. [1] Decide on cadence (weekly, biweekly, monthly) and agree on attendance and rescheduling expectations. [1] Choose in-person, online, or hybrid — and the tools you'll use. [1]

**Define House Rules**: Confirm which optional rules are in play (flanking, feats, multiclassing) and agree on rolling method, inspiration, and critical-hit rules. [1] Clarify how you'll handle rules disputes mid-session. [1]

**Connect the Party**: Decide how the characters already know each other and give the group a shared goal or reason to adventure together. [1] End Session Zero with a one-line summary of the campaign's promise. [2]

**Run Every Session Like a Legend**: Once your Session Zero notes are set, keep your most-used references at your fingertips. [1] Use the [Ultimate Game Master Screen](https://theultimategamemaster.com/products/ultimate-game-master-screen-brown-portrait) to snap initiative, house rules, and campaign notes exactly where you want them — and wipe clean for your next adventure. [1]
